32. The Annual Report of the Council shall include the
Financial  statements  and  accounts,  the  balance  sheet  and
the  auditor’s  report  prepared  for  a  period  of  twelve  (12)
months commencing on the first day of April each year and
ending on the thirty first day of March of the following year.
33. All debts and liabilities of the Institute existing on the
day preceding the date of commencement of this Act, shall be
paid or discharged by the body corporate hereby constituted
and all debts due to, and subscriptions and fees payable to the
Institute on that day, shall be paid to the body corporate for the
purposes of this Act.
34 .The Seal of the body corporate shall not be affixed to
any  instrument  whatsoever  except  in  the  presence  of  the
Secretary  or  a  member  of  the  council  who  may  be  duly
authorized by the council and another member of the council
and who shall sign their names on the instrument in token of
their presence and such signing shall be independent of the
signing of any person as a witness.
